title: For each VM state among instances in availability zone "flare3" running on
question: For each VM state among instances in availability zone "flare3" running on host "blaze8-12", list the VM state, the number of instances, the total vCPUs, the maximum memory (MB) used by any instance in that VM state, and compute the max-to-average memory ratio (max memory divided by the average memory for that VM state, rounded to 2 decimals) along with the average deviation from overall average memory (rounded to 2 decimals).

prediction.sql:
WITH filtered_instances AS (
  SELECT vm_state, vcpus, memory_mb
  FROM instances
  WHERE availability_zone = 'flare3' AND host = 'blaze8-12'
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(memory_mb) AS overall_avg_memory
  FROM filtered_instances
),
state_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    vm_state,
    COUNT(*) AS instance_count,
    SUM(vcpus) AS total_vcpus,
    MAX(memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb,
    AVG(memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb,
    AVG(memory_mb - (SELECT overall_avg_memory FROM overall_avg)) AS avg_deviation
  FROM filtered_instances
  GROUP BY vm_state
)
SELECT 
  ss.vm_state,
  ss.instance_count,
  ss.total_vcpus,
  ss.max_memory_mb,
  ROUND(ss.max_memory_mb / NULLIF(ss.avg_memory_mb, 0), 2) AS max_to_avg_memory_ratio,
  ROUND(ss.avg_deviation, 2) AS avg_deviation_from_overall_avg_memory
FROM state_stats ss
ORDER BY ss.vm_state

projection_contract.role: aggregation role: VM state, the number of instances, the total vCPUs, the maximum memory (MB) used

aggregation role: any instance in that VM state, and compute the max-to-average memory ratio (max memory divided by the average memory for that VM state, rounded to 2 decimals) along with the average deviation from overall average memory (rounded to 2 decimals)

historical_programs.sql_template: WITH prime_variability AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(c.updated_at - i.created_at) / NULLIF(AVG(c.updated_at - i.created_at), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS e ON e.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS c ON c.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(c.updated_at - i.created_at) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.coefficient_of_variation, ac.avg_coefficient_of_variation AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.coefficient_of_variation > ac.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN ic.coefficient_of_variation < ac.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS ac ORDER BY ic.coefficient_of_variation DESC), flare_memory AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ie.CREATED_AT AS instance_extra_created_at, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'flare') ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(memory_mb) AS overall_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.hostname, ic.memory_mb, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.instance_extra_created_at, ic.window_column, oa.overall_avg_memory_mb, (ic.memory_mb - oa.overall_avg_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_overall_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS oa ORDER BY ic.memory_mb), CombinedResults AS (SELECT pv.display_name AS entity_name, pv.coefficient_of_variation AS metric_value, pv.benchmark AS benchmark_value, pv.variability_category AS category, 'Prime display-name cache-update variability' AS reason FROM prime_variability AS pv UNION ALL SELECT fm.instance_uuid AS entity_name, fm.deviation_from_overall_avg_memory_mb AS metric_value, fm.overall_avg_memory_mb AS benchmark_value, CASE WHEN fm.deviation_from_overall_avg_memory_mb > 0 THEN 'ABOVE_OVERALL_AVG' WHEN fm.deviation_from_overall_avg_memory_mb < 0 THEN 'BELOW_OVERALL_AVG' ELSE 'AT_OVERALL_AVG' END AS category, 'Flare3 instance memory deviation' AS reason FROM flare_memory AS fm) SELECT entity_name, metric_value, benchmark_value, category, reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY entity_name
